shouldTrigger: Chief, make a reusable skill for yourself that turns my weekly project notes into a decision brief.
Create a private skill for my Research bot to compare competitors using its existing research tools.
I keep asking my planning bot for the same vendor comparison. Turn that workflow into a skill it can reuse.
shouldNotTrigger: Summarize this week's project notes once, then give me the decision brief.
Remember that I prefer concise comparison tables.
Run the Deep Research skill on these competitors.
expectations: The bot identifies the intended owner, recurring trigger, required inputs, observable output, and boundaries before creating a skill.
The bot checks existing skills and limits required tools to those already assigned to the intended bot.
An explicit creation request results in one private skill attached to the intended bot; a draft-only or one-off request does not cause a mutation.
The bot never claims to grant new tools or connections, publish the skill, or create one during a group or scheduled run.
